      "db": "tianyancha",
      "op": "company_basic",
      "purpose": "企业基础工商信息",

      "web_adapter": "ENABLED_TYPED_WHITELIST",
      "notes": "none"

      "db": "tianyancha",
      "op": "company_profile",
      "purpose": "企业身份、基础工商、股东；可选直接投资及主要人员",
      "syntax": "q=全称/统一信用码；n=1；x.include可含investments/personnel；x.max_pages=1..3；x.shareholder_source=1或2",
      "provider_test": "REAL_GITHUB_BATCH_PASS",
      "github_adapter": "ENABLED_TYPED_WHITELIST",
      "notes": "Partial pages/publication are marked; names alone do not prove same person or legal relationship.",

        "basic": "PASS",
        "shareholders": "PASS",
        "personnel": "PASS",

      }
    },
    {
      "db": "yuandian_law",

      "provider_test": "PASS",
      "web_adapter": "ENABLED_TYPED_WHITELIST",
      "notes": "provider-derived fields remain labeled"
    },
    {
      "db": "yuandian_law",
      "op": "case_detail",

      "web_adapter": "ENABLED_TYPED_WHITELIST",

    {
      "db": "yuandian_law",
      "op": "law_search",
      "purpose": "法条关键词检索",

      "sample": "民法典违约责任法条：1条",
      "provider_test": "PASS",
      "web_adapter": "ENABLED_TYPED_WHITELIST",
      "notes": "LLM拼接内容 is not original text"

    {
      "db": "yuandian_law",
      "op": "law_detail",
